# Google Chat Takeout fixtures

`redacted-public/` contains derivatives of public 2024 Google Chat Takeout
samples. Names, addresses, identifiers, text, URLs, and media were replaced;
provider structure and relationships remain. The niimpy sample retains its
[MIT license](redacted-public/niimpy/LICENSE).

`takeout/` contains synthetic data. Multipart and other edge cases are also
synthetic. These fixtures do not establish support for current exports.
